authorHistory.work: Earlier proofreading corrected directive types, date formats, currency validation, and upper behavior.

checks.claim: Member and Administrator access; Form section and Upload version
checks.actual: The routed builder is restricted to Member+ and opens Upload version from the template pane.

checks.claim: Placeholder slug length and marker parts
checks.actual: Slug validation uses the saved field bound of 120; text parts include body, numbered headers/footers, footnotes and endnotes.

checks.claim: Supported directives and new field types
checks.actual: Exactly one upper/date/currency directive is accepted. Date patterns are YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY and MMMM D, YYYY. Currency codes are validated against supported currencies. detectedFields mints date or currency fields when required; conflicting type requirements stay text. upper has no type requirement.

checks.claim: Clause rule editing and detection refusals
checks.actual: When a rule matches exposes field, operator and value controls; absent rules include the Block. Invalid slugs, directives, braces and unclosed Blocks are refused with source text.

checks.claim: Orphans, immutable file/form versions and publication
checks.actual: Uploads retain prior fields and append a form version. Orphan fields say No Placeholder in file version N. The Publish dialog selects both file and form versions, leaving the live pair unchanged until publication.

limitations: Source inspection supports technical accuracy; the separately recorded independent V-C56 browser walkthrough is required before verification.
